settings.title: Impostazioni budget
settings.cadenceLocked: The cadence can't be changed yet.

carryDescription.floor: Money left in a line moves to the next period. Overspending does not.
carryDescription.signed: Both leftovers and overspending move to the next period.
carryDescription.none: Every line starts at zero, whatever happened before.

settings.deleteConfirmDescription: It's kept for 30 days, then deleted. You can restore it until then.
settings.deleteError: Couldn't move the budget to trash

trialNotice.active: Early adopter trial: {count} day of budgeting left | Early adopter trial: {count} days of budgeting left
trialNotice.ended: Your budgeting trial has ended, so your budget is read-only.
trialNotice.offer: Early adopters get Essential at 50% off.

empty.title: Dai uno scopo ai tuoi soldi
empty.description: Bastano due minuti per impostarlo e pochi minuti a settimana per mantenerlo.

accounts.title: Scegli i conti che usi per le spese
accounts.description: Conti correnti, contanti e carte di credito. Puoi escludere i risparmi.

suggested.title: Parti dalle voci che ti suggeriamo
suggested.description: Le categorie con più spese degli ultimi 3 mesi, già compilate con il relativo importo medio.

available.title: Tieni d’occhio quanto ti resta
available.description: Ogni acquisto viene conteggiato nella sua voce: saprai quanto ti resta senza doverlo stimare.

trashed.title: Recently deleted budgets
trashed.description: Kept for {days} days, then removed for good.
trashed.currencyMismatch: Budgeted in {planCurrency}. Your base currency is now {baseCurrency}, so it can't be restored.
trashed.purgeDescription: Its lines, goals and assigned amounts are removed for good. Your transactions are not touched.
trashed.settingsRowHint: {count} budget, kept for {days} days | {count} budgets, kept for {days} days
trashed.replaceDescription: You can have one budget at a time. {restored} becomes your budget, and {current} moves to Recently deleted for 30 days.

create.title: Inizia a pianificare il budget
create.description: Scegli ogni quanto reimpostare il budget e quali conti includere.
create.noAccountsTitle: Non ci sono ancora conti da includere nel budget
create.noAccountsDescription: Per creare un budget serve almeno un conto corrente, di risparmio, in contanti o una carta di credito intestati a te. Aggiungine uno nella pagina Conti, poi torna qui.
create.suggestedLinesFailed: Non è stato possibile aggiungere le voci suggerite. Puoi aggiungerle dal budget.
create.suggestedLinesHint: Usa le spese degli ultimi 3 mesi per creare gruppi e voci, compilando ciascun importo con la media. Se non hai uno storico, aggiunge un modello iniziale. Bastano pochi secondi; potrai modificare o rimuovere le voci in seguito.
create.askQuestionsHint: Pochi passaggi per un budget più adatto a te.
create.askQuestionsNeedsAi: Richiede l’IA. In alternativa, le voci suggerite useranno il modello standard.
create.customEveryError: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.

suggest.title: Definisci le voci del budget
suggest.descriptionHistory: Combiniamo le tue risposte con le spese degli ultimi tre mesi.
suggest.descriptionNoHistory: Non hai ancora registrato spese: useremo le tue risposte per creare le voci.

defaultsConfirm.title: Usare le voci predefinite?
defaultsConfirm.description: Le tue risposte non verranno considerate e saranno create le voci predefinite.

housing.question: Qual è la tua situazione abitativa?
housing.owned: La casa è di proprietà, senza mutuo

transport.question: Come ti sposti di solito?
transport.bikeWalk: Mi sposto in bici o a piedi

eatsOut.question: Quanto spesso mangi fuori o ordini cibo?

focus.questionHistory: What do you want to watch closely?
focus.hintHistory: Select all that apply. Each gets more detailed lines.
focus.questionNoHistory: What else do you spend on?
focus.hintNoHistory: Select all that apply. Each gets its own line.

detail.question: How detailed should your budget be?

suggest.contextError: Impossibile caricare le tue spese. Riprova.
suggest.answersIgnored: I suggerimenti intelligenti non erano disponibili, quindi le tue risposte non sono state usate. Sono state aggiunte le voci predefinite.

grid.archiveDescription: It stops counting from this period on. Past periods keep their numbers. You can restore it later from "Archived".
grid.archiveManyDescription: They stop counting from this period on. Past periods keep their numbers. You can restore them later from "Archived".
grid.deleteDescription: Its assigned amounts are deleted and its spending will show as outside your lines. This can't be undone.
grid.deleteHistoryDescription: It's removed from every period, including past ones, and its assigned amounts are deleted. Its spending will show as outside your lines. This can't be undone.
grid.deleteArchiveHint: We recommend archiving it instead to keep its history. You can restore it later from "Archived".
grid.noLinesDescription: Add a line to set a spending limit for a group of categories.
grid.noSuggestions: Nothing to suggest: the suggested categories already have lines.

archivedLines.title: Archived lines
archivedLines.description: A restored line resumes from the current period. Past periods stay as they are.

unbudgeted.summary: Spending outside your lines: {amount} in {count} category | Spending outside your lines: {amount} in {count} categories

calc.title: Budget calculation
calc.cashHint: Cash in the plan's accounts, minus credit limits.
calc.driftHint: Rate moves and balances not explained by transactions.
calc.committedLaterHint: Already assigned in a later period.

pool.settingHint: Income goes into a ready to assign pool that you hand out to lines.
pool.createHint: Income goes into a ready to assign pool that you hand out to lines. You can change this later in settings.
pool.enableConfirmTitle: Fund this plan from a pool?
pool.enableConfirmDescription: The pool starts from the current period. Earlier periods won't show ready to assign.
pool.zeroSumHint: The header asks you to assign what's left until ready to assign is 0.
pool.zeroSumNag: Assign the rest to keep ready to assign at 0
pool.fixNoLines: There is nothing to take back in this period.

groups.deleteBlocked: Move or archive its lines first
groups.deleteDescription: Its archived lines become ungrouped. This cannot be undone.
groups.layoutDescription: Drag lines within and between groups, and drag groups to reorder them.

goals.askHint: Assign this amount here to stay on track.
goals.deleteDescription: This will remove the goal from {line}. Your assigned amounts will not be affected.

behaviorDescription.budget_another: Budgets the amount fresh each period. Spending along the way is expected and never changes the ask.
behaviorDescription.refill_up_to: Refills the line to the target each period. Whatever is left over counts, so you assign only the gap.
behaviorDescription.reach_balance: Tracks the balance itself. Spending sets progress back and raises the ask right away.

goals.refillUpToHint: The balance to restore each period.
goals.totalToBudgetHint: Split across the periods until the date.
goals.openEndedHint: No deadline. Progress tracks the line balance.
goals.firstDueDateHint: Repeats yearly on this date. Funding is spread across the periods before it.
goals.repeatHint: Start a new cycle after the due period.
goals.stopAtBalanceHint: Stop asking once the saved balance (carryover plus assigned) reaches this cap.

errors.dueDateFuture: The due date must be after today
errors.repeatEvery: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}

byDateRepeating.months: by {date}, repeating every {count} month | by {date}, repeating every {count} months
byDateRepeating.years: by {date}, repeating every {count} year | by {date}, repeating every {count} years

month.yearlyHint: Spread over the months of each yearly cycle.

period.yearlyHint: Spread over the periods of each yearly cycle.
